risks.risk: Capacity may not be 20kg (could be smaller/larger), which changes value.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity marking (e.g., '20kg') and serial/registration details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an LPG cylinder with unknown capacity (worst-case for value: treat as not confirmed 20kg).

risks.risk: Cylinder condition/age may be poor (rust, dents, valve wear), affecting safety and refill acceptance.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the entire body (including bottom ring/foot), and the valve/regulator connection area; also show any dents/leaks indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a cylinder in used/possibly worn condition (worst-case: assume it may need servicing and may be harder to refill).

risks.risk: Leak/valve integrity not testable from the photo.
risks.proof: Video of a leak test (soap-bubble test at valve/regulator joints) and confirmation that the valve opens/closes properly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed leak-free (worst-case: treat as requiring inspection/possible non-usable).

risks.risk: Refill eligibility may be affected by inspection/expiry status or missing documentation.
risks.proof: Photo of any inspection/expiry stamp/label and any cylinder identification plate/markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as refill eligibility not confirmed (worst-case: assume buyer may face refusal or extra cost).

proof_requests: Close-up photo showing the cylinder capacity marking (confirm '20kg') and any stamped serial/ID.
Close-up photos of the valve/regulator and the full cylinder body (especially bottom/foot ring) showing dents/rust clearly.
Short video leak test at the valve/regulator joints (soap-bubble test) and valve operation (open/close).
Photo of any inspection/expiry stamp or label on the cylinder.
response.reason: The photo shows an LPG cylinder but does not clearly confirm the 20kg capacity or the cylinder’s condition/eligibility; without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
